name: starhunt
description: Source software engineers from GitHub, ranked by what they build.

interface.shortDescription: Find engineers by what they build on GitHub
interface.longDescription: Search GitHub developers by technology, role and location, or from a pasted job description. Results are ranked on evidence of real work: contributions merged over the last twelve months, the languages in a developer's own repositories, and how recently they shipped. Each profile carries the public email or LinkedIn that person chose to publish. Save the ones worth pursuing to a pipeline and read it back later, without leaving the conversation.
defaultPrompt: Find AI product engineers in San Francisco who ship Python in production.
Here is my job post, find me ten matching engineers in Berlin.
Who have I saved to my pipeline and not contacted yet?
